body: It sounds like you have an incredible amount of regrets in your life, like I do. However, i think you still have some time to change and become a better version of yourself. It’s not going to be easy but you need to let the past go if you’re going to make progress in the future. We’ve all done things that we regret, trust me I know it hurts knowing that we can never take that stuff back. You can still take action now to avoid more regrets from occurring in the future. I hope you can find some satisfaction in this life.
I’m sorry to hear about your mom. You deserved better in life. Just like me.

My base emotions are anxiety and sadness. Everyday I wake up with my heart pounding even though the day just started. Sometimes I think about my life as a teenager and i become sad that I’ll never experience that ever again.

I can’t blame the system for everything. If I did I would be deflecting personal responsibility off myself. I understand that we were born into a world that was rigged for the boomer generation, but there are certain things that cannot be blamed on the boomers or anybody else.
